articles.title: DefiLlama delayed mobile launch over phishing apps on Apple Store, founder says
articles.snippet: DefiLlama’s founder said Apple removed one fake app within days after the company documented it draining funds from a small crypto wallet.

articles.title: JPMorgan boosts Bitcoin, Ether ETF positions in Q2 filing
articles.snippet: JPMorgan reported a 25% increase in its Bitcoin ETF position and more than quadrupled its Ether ETF position in the second quarter.

articles.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash Review: Google's Cheap Model Isn’t Dumb Anymore
articles.snippet: Three weeks after a Flash release that couldn't produce a working file, Google's budget tier zero-shots a playable game. It still can't reason, and a free 27B model still writes better.

articles.title: Meta Patents Cameras That Recognize Faces and Log Your Actions
articles.snippet: The filing would turn raw footage into labeled clips of who did what, without anyone opting in.
